phases.name: ICD Pocket Healing & Shock Preparedness
phases.clinical_note: Pocket protection, arm restriction, review what to do if shock is delivered

advance_criteria.description: Pocket healed, pacing stable, no inappropriate shocks

meals.name: Heart-Healthy Lunch
meals.notes: Grilled poultry or legumes, spinach salad, olive oil

meals.name: Light Digestible Dinner
meals.notes: Baked white fish or lentils with zucchini

instructions: Keep operative arm below shoulder height for 4 weeks
Gentle walking: 10-15 minutes on level ground
Avoid contact sports or direct pressure on device

checks.name: ICD Pocket Inspection
checks.target: No redness, warmth, hematoma, or discharge

checks.name: Heart Rate & Rhythm Log
checks.target: Ensure rate is above programmed baseline

checks.name: Palpitation / Pre-Syncope Check
checks.target: Report any flutter sensations or near-fainting immediately

templates.focus_note: Ensure stable lead placement and understand emergency procedures for device discharge.
